name: dkj-subagents-alpha
displayName: Claude Specialists — team alpha (the core team, subagent scaffold)
description: The Claude Specialists core team: a team of specialised Claudes who work anywhere, with or without a repository -- a researcher, a copy editor, a designer, a planner, a product owner, a data analyst, a UX designer, a long-form writer, a biographer and an investigative journalist -- led by Chris, the Chief of Staff, who reads your request, tells you who will handle it and keeps the work on course. Enable it wherever you want to work with the team, the Claude App included; the other teams add to it and never replace it. The specialists whose craft needs a repository (the repository engineer, the release manager, the system administrator, the app developer, the test engineer, the reviewers and the technical writer) and the skills that set the team up in a repo are in dkj-subagents-developers, which every repo enables beside this one. WHAT YOU GET: the specialists, the voices the main conversation speaks in, and the orchestrator skill. This plugin ships no hook and no script.
